title.zh: 将宿务省 Tuburan市镇 Tuburan 国立职业学校的名称变更为Tuburan 国立学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Tuburan National Vocational School in the Municipality of Tuburan, Province of Cebu, to Tuburan National School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Tuburan National Vocational School in the Municipality of Tuburan, Province of Cebu, to Tuburan National School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1962/ra_3503_1962.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Tuburan National Vocational School in the Municipality of Tuburan, Province of Cebu, is hereby changed to Tuburan National School. General courses as well as vocational courses shall be offered in said school.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1962.
